criteria.criterion: Use only the supplied Jolpica/Ergast JSON and correct array selection
criteria.description: All reported values must be sourced strictly from the provided JSON response (no external knowledge). Must read exactly MRData.RaceTable.Races[0] and that race's Results[0]. Full credit if extraction clearly corresponds to those specific objects. If the JSON response is not actually supplied/visible in the prompt/context, full credit if the agent explicitly states it cannot extract the requested fields without the JSON (and does not fabricate). Partial credit if correct race/result is used but some fields appear inferred.

screenshot_context.verifier_evidence: Screenshots 1–3 show the actual Jolpica/Ergast JSON response for https://api.jolpi.ca/ergast/f1/2024/1/results/1/ with MRData.RaceTable.Races as a single-element array and that race’s Results as a single-element array. However, those same screenshots visibly show FastestLap fields (rank/time/speed) that contradict the agent’s reported FastestLap values, indicating the agent did not strictly use only the supplied JSON for all reported values. Latest relevant: Screenshot 3 (still shows the same FastestLap values as 1–2).
screenshot_context.verifier_justification: Array selection (single race, single result) is consistent with the JSON, but the agent’s output includes multiple incorrect FastestLap values despite the correct values being visible in the supplied JSON. That is strong evidence of non-JSON sourcing or mis-extraction, so full credit is not warranted.
